note: BH-9177. With SELECTION_GATE_SUITE_REUSE=1: 1 sends a suite that has a fail row in the suite ledger at its fingerprint to the test host again, as before. 0: the suite is not sent and is a red of the gate (red:, or noted: when quarantined). 1 by default because a fail row is sticky at its key and the builder's fix turn needs the suite's log. bin/lib/selection-gate.sh reads the row; bin/lib/selection-gate-reuse.sh falls back to 1.
